workspace.title: Charging Places
workspace.unifiedDescription: Manage zone boundaries, alerts, categories, charging rates, and session history in one place.
workspace.noSearchMatches: No places match this search. Clear the search to see all places.

needsSetup.title: Needs Setup
needsSetup.empty: All caught up — no auto-discovered places need review.

chargingPlaces.empty: No active places yet. Existing and future confirmed charging locations appear automatically.
chargingPlaces.emptyAll: No places or zones yet. Charge somewhere or add a place to start.

detail.pricingIntro: Rate changes never rewrite protected actual costs. The rate active today estimates older unpriced sessions automatically; use preview and apply when you have exact historical rates.

rateForm.title: Add a Rate
rateForm.effectiveToHint: Leave blank for an open-ended rate.
rateForm.legacyEstimateHint: If this rate is active today, it also estimates older unpriced sessions at this place. Existing actual costs stay unchanged.

rateHistory.title: Rate History
rateHistory.empty: No rate configured yet — use the form above to start pricing sessions at this place.
rateHistory.previewHelp: Preview sessions shows which historical charges match a rate and what would change before anything is applied.
rateHistory.deleteMessage: The previous rate will continue through this cancelled schedule. Effective rate history cannot be deleted.

previewApply.title: Session Pricing Preview
previewApply.selectRate: Choose Preview sessions on a rate to see affected charging sessions and estimated cost.
previewApply.help: This preview is read-only. It shows matching historical sessions and estimated cost; nothing changes until you choose Apply.
previewApply.metricsHelp: Matched sessions are in this place and rate period. Eligible sessions can be priced; protected sessions keep their existing cost.
previewApply.confirmTitle: Apply this rate to matching sessions?
previewApply.confirmMessage: This backfills/reprices unpriced or previously geofence-derived sessions in scope. Manual, Tesla-reported, and existing costs with unknown provenance are never overwritten.
previewApply.confirmAttributionTitle: Assign matching sessions to this place?
previewApply.confirmAttributionMessage: Matching sessions will be linked to this place. Their protected costs will remain unchanged.
previewApply.noMatches: No sessions match this place and rate period. Check the zone location and radius, or broaden the optional date range. Sessions without coordinates can match an identical saved place name.
previewApply.attributionOnly: All matched costs are protected. Apply can still assign unlinked sessions to this place without changing their cost.
previewApply.applied: Processed {{matched}} matched sessions: {{priced}} priced, {{skipped}} protected or unchanged, {{cost}} total.

summary.title: Charging Summary
summary.empty: No priced charging activity at this place yet.

activity.title: Charging Activity
activity.empty: No charging sessions recorded at this place yet.

geofences.noPosition: No position data available for this vehicle
geofences.drawHint: Click the circle tool, then click and drag on the map to draw a fence.

aiSuggest.title: Suggest a geofence for this location
aiSuggest.description: Propose a typed geofence draft (centroid, radius, and name) for this visited location based on its visit pattern. Review only — Helix never saves the geofence; you confirm and save via the existing baseline Add Geofence form.
aiSuggest.pickLocation: Pick a visited location to draft a geofence around
aiSuggest.pickHint: Paste a visited-location ID from the Locations page to draft a zone around it.

aiAutoName.title: Suggest a name for this location
aiAutoName.description: Propose a concise, human-readable name for this visited location based on its visit pattern. Review only — Helix never saves the name; you confirm and save via the existing baseline form.

mapOverview.heading: Heading
mapOverview.noHistoryDescription: Location history appears after the selected vehicle reports valid GPS positions.
mapOverview.subtitle: Live vehicle location and recent history
mapOverview.noPlayback: Not enough GPS points to replay a route yet.

tempImpact.tipHot: Park in shade during hot weather to preserve battery efficiency
tempImpact.title: Temperature Impact
tempImpact.subtitle: How outside temperature affects driving efficiency
tempImpact.tipOptimal: Best efficiency observed in the {{range}} range
tempImpact.optimalDesc: Your most efficient temperature range is {{range}} with an average of {{efficiency}} {{unit}} across {{count}} drives.
tempImpact.optimalDelta: Compared to the worst range ({{worst}}), you save {{delta}} {{unit}} on average.

aiNarrative.title: Narrate the cabin-temperature impact
aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain how outside ambient temperature affects this vehicle's efficiency — which temperature bucket runs most efficiently, how cold-weather months compare with mild-weather months, and what the seasonal pattern in the chart implies. The bucket and monthly numbers are the same the chart below shows; the narrator only explains them and is honest that these are descriptive aggregates of recent drives, not a forecast.
aiNarrative.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to narrate its temperature impact.

tempImpact.monthlyAria: Monthly drive count bars and average temperature line
